name: Operational Definition Substitution
description: Removes all explicit algebraic inequalities from the problem description and replaces them with purely operational descriptions of the lower bounds on completion time (e.g., "even if it were the only request"). This defeats models that rely on scanning the text for formulas to evaluate, forcing them to derive the required mathematical checks (p1+p2 > T and sum(p) > T) from the physical constraints of the described pipeline.
